bug_semantics: Genkit's unauthenticated developer servers accepted requests on non-loopback interfaces without validating the HTTP Host header. A LAN peer, or a website using DNS rebinding, could invoke registered actions through the Tools/Dev UI runAction API with attacker-controlled input and context (including forged context.auth) and read the result; the telemetry trace SSE endpoint additionally widened CORS to '*', exposing action traces. CORS origin response headers were not an authorization gate.
flaw_origin: The earliest public carrier is GitHub squash aggregate 91ed3de52e7db92943886526395ad8eac6faa77f ('Added runner, action reflection, and typed registry. (#3)'). It simultaneously makes `genkit start` start a Runner API, adds the unauthenticated runAction proxy, and adds a Reflection API whose `/api/runAction` executes registry actions while both Express servers call `listen(port)` without a host or Host check. Its message enumerates many squashed member changes, including 'Added basic Reflection API', 'Added starting of app code when starting Runner API', and 'Implemented passthrough endpoints in Runner API'. The member commit objects/parents needed to distinguish which smallest member first completed the vulnerable path are not in the public repository, so the aggregate is not recorded as the BIC.
ai_marker: Unavailable for the true BIC because the introducing PR's squashed member commit object is outside public history. `git cat-file -p 91ed3de52e7db92943886526395ad8eac6faa77f` shows human author Alex Pascal <apascal07@gmail.com>, GitHub committer <noreply@github.com>, and no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, bot, or other AI trailer on the public squash aggregate, but aggregate-level absence cannot establish BIC-only absence.
evidence: Advisory/CNA: CVE-2026-67179 and GHSA-vj3w-h7v3-5rpr describe unauthenticated POST /api/runAction access via LAN/DNS rebinding and claim a custom date boundary of 2026-06-18; issue https://github.com/genkit-ai/genkit/issues/5581 supplies the reproduced 1.36.0 attack and identifies Tools server.ts, telemetry index.ts, and reflection.ts. Origin: `git show 91ed3de52e7db92943886526395ad8eac6faa77f -- genkit-tools/src/commands/start.ts genkit-tools/src/runner/router.ts genkit-tools/src/runner/runner.ts` shows start.ts calling `new Runner().start()`, unauthenticated RUNNER_ROUTER.runAction forwarding to the Reflection API, and `api.listen(port)` with no host. The same aggregate creates genkit/common/src/reflectionApi.ts with POST /api/runAction calling registry.lookupAction(key)(input) and `api.listen(numericPort)`. Direct parent check: `git grep -n -E 'runAction|startReflectionApi|Runner API running' 805600159f34ca96d95c26c10c7b2799cb5951ce -- genkit-tools genkit/common` finds only the pre-existing unimplemented Runner server log line and no runAction or Reflection execution path; `git diff 805600159f34ca96d95c26c10c7b2799cb5951ce 91ed3de52e7db92943886526395ad8eac6faa77f` shows the vulnerable path appears in the aggregate. History cross-checks: `git log --follow --reverse -- genkit-tools/src/runner/runner.ts` reaches 91ed after the earlier stub-only Runner API; later 64c94c0bbcc86db000e821bc7b18264057641315 and 61129e141c3257e374f8c48eb1de6a5cad4c3096 are respectively a rename/combination and package extraction, not BICs. `git log -S"'/api/runAction'" --follow -- genkit-tools/common/src/server/server.ts` identifies later 978e3ddae0d0e527b2521aeaa9ee8e18a429c7dd, which added the direct Dev UI route and wildcard trace SSE but is not the origin because action execution was already network-reachable through the Runner/Reflection path. Squash boundary: `git cat-file -p 91ed...` has one parent and a 27-item squashed message; the current repository was created 2024-04-29, its PR #3 is unrelated, the commit-to-pulls API returns [], GitHub commit search returns only copies of the aggregate, and `git fsck --unreachable --no-reflogs` plus inspection of preserved early branch commits does not recover the named PR-member objects. Releases: the carrier predates the first repository tags 0.5.0-rc.9 (2edaaab625eb2274f182421ef13f5464f20df982) and 0.5.0, so those and later releases inherited the flaw. `git show -s genkit-cli@1.39.0 genkit-cli@1.40.0` resolves to 54c60aab1c89844e0ba6231f46f9a13241e6368c and c85153e04c766300fa2fdd755393076657f2a216. Commit 66bfbbc5198db40e236d61760ea5ab2b34aac75c, first released in genkit-cli@1.40.0, changed Tools, telemetry, and reflection listeners to 127.0.0.1 and closes direct LAN reachability, but adds no Host validation; `git grep` shows 1.39.0 uses `app.listen(port)` and 1.40.0 defaults to 127.0.0.1. Latest tag genkit-cli@1.42.0 still has no rejectNonLoopbackHost or req.headers.host check, so DNS rebinding to loopback remains. Proposed PR #5587 is still open: fb00011b5aade16638c9f6b72502e2085d94ca51 adds loopback Host validation and removes wildcard SSE CORS for Tools/telemetry; 34ec0a6ca0bfc7b2caedd7524939779556317da0 does the same for reflection; `git branch -r --contains fb00011...` is empty. Therefore no landed complete fix SHA or fully fixed package version exists despite the CNA's date-only 'fixed' assertion.
reasoning: The vulnerability existed once the developer workflow exposed a callable action proxy/reflection handler on an all-interface, unauthenticated Express listener; later direct-route, telemetry, rename, extraction, and refactor commits expanded or moved an already vulnerable mechanism and cannot be the smallest BIC. Public history proves that 91ed's parent lacks the executable action path and that the squash result contains it, but the protocol forbids treating a squash aggregate as the BIC. Because the private/squashed member object and its immediate parent cannot be recovered, direct parent absence and AI attribution cannot be performed on the true smallest commit. That is a genuine public-history boundary, requiring BLOCKED rather than NOT_AI based on the aggregate's human identity. Separately, 66bf is only partial hardening: loopback binding blocks LAN access but does not validate Host and therefore does not close DNS rebinding. The open #5587 commits demonstrate the missing remediation but are neither merged nor released, so fix fields are null and the case remains unpatched for the full advisory semantics.
remaining_gap: BLOCKED on unavailable squash-member history: obtain the original private FirebasePrivate PR #3 member commit that first completed the runnable unauthenticated action path, its immediate parent, and that member commit object's author/committer/trailers. Also no complete upstream fix has landed as of 2026-08-28: PR #5587's Host-validation series remains open, while released 66bfbbc5198db40e236d61760ea5ab2b34aac75c only binds to loopback and leaves the DNS-rebinding Host-header flaw unpatched.
